intent.title: Settle the review-side design
intent.request: Deferred from #1: the review-side design questions.
intent.problem: Review-side questions were left open until real result gates had been run, so reviews couldn't be designed with confidence.
acceptance: Each question below is decided after reviewing at least one real step result.

decisions.question: Can reviews of your own agents' work skip the plan (observed-only), or only reviews of other people's changes?
decisions.answer: Own work too, with a reason: your agents may skip the plan (spikes, hotfixes) by passing the explicit flag and a one-line reason. These reviews never count as 'verified' and are listed separately in every filter.

decisions.question: Where do approvals live once there's a team: here or in pull-request reviews?
decisions.answer: refs/ldd, mirrored: approvals are passkey-signed events in refs/ldd (#3 Q8). The coordinator mirrors the gate to the forge as a required check. A PR approval never decides a gate, so the record works the same on every forge, including bare remotes.

decisions.question: Should inline review views show only the rows that need a decision?
decisions.answer: All rows in chat, sorted: the chat widget lists every row, with the ones needing attention (unplanned, missing, breaking, inferred) first. Everything stays in one place, accepting that a large change makes the widget long and costly.

deferred.item: Whether reviews of other people's changes reach their authors (was Q2).
deferred.reason: Only local mode is in scope for now (user, 2026-09-29).
